title: silene tridentata var. coarctata
intro: Silene tridentata var. coarctata, commonly known as the narrow-leaved catchfly, is a plant species within the Caryophyllaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis. The narrow-leaved catchfly has been reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents. Some of the key bioactive constituents in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
